title: Building 2Africa, a transformative subsea cable to better connect Africa
lineage: Original publication on the issuing organisation’s website.

passages.locator: Consortium, design and open landing paragraphs
passages.note: The project announcement names spatial-division multiplexing SDM1 as the 2Africa cable technology and gives its design maximum of 16 fibre pairs. It separately describes wavelength-selective switching. The reported capacity and service dates were design or construction-stage expectations.
